title: English Practice Quiz 0975
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A hazard is something that can ___.
questions.explanation: A hazard is a source or situation with potential to cause harm.

questions.question: Before using unfamiliar equipment, you should ___.
options: read the instructions and receive proper guidance
questions.explanation: Instructions and training help prevent misuse and injury.

questions.question: An emergency exit should be ___.
questions.explanation: Clear exits allow people to leave safely in an emergency.

questions.question: A near miss is an event that ___.
options: could have caused harm but did not
questions.explanation: Near misses reveal risks before an injury occurs.

questions.question: If you notice a damaged electrical cable, you should ___.
options: keep people away and report it promptly
questions.explanation: A damaged cable can cause electric shock or fire.

questions.question: A safety briefing is intended to ___.
questions.explanation: Briefings communicate hazards and required precautions.

questions.question: Personal protective equipment is commonly abbreviated as ___.
questions.explanation: PPE stands for personal protective equipment.

questions.question: A spill on a walkway should be ___.
options: reported and dealt with using the correct procedure
ignored until the end of the week
questions.explanation: Prompt action helps prevent slips and falls.

questions.question: An incident report should use language that is ___.
questions.explanation: Objective wording records what happened without speculation.

questions.question: During an evacuation, people should follow ___.
options: the crowd into a restricted area
questions.explanation: Established procedures guide people to safer evacuation routes.
